propositions: Rebar's deterministic repair and sentinel extraction logic in structured.parse_structured must be exposed as a Pydantic TextOutput function that raises ModelRetry on retryable errors while preserving the original StructuredOutputError in the exception chain

The existing stop/refusal and content-filter guards from structured.check_response must be implemented as a Pydantic after_model_request capability hook that terminates with UnretryableOutputError after one model call without triggering Pydantic retry prompts

The new pai_output.py adapter must integrate with documented Pydantic AI 1.107.x seams (TextOutputFunc and AbstractCapability) without adding retry loops, provider selection, usage tracking, or persistence logic
Historical repair, sentinel selection, and decoy-plus-valid-object handling must produce identical results before and after the adapter with no changes to structured.py parser behavior
